name: CTA
description: A call to action: a short heading, an optional line of text and one or two buttons — across the whole section, or as a card inside it.

layout.description: inline: text left, buttons right on wide screens. centered: everything centred. stacked: heading, text and buttons in one column at the start edge on every width.

frame.description: full: the tone fills the section. card: a rounded box in a plain section carries the tone.

tone.description: Background. On accent, primary buttons are drawn in the secondary style so they stay visible. brand: the site's brand colour role (`--color-brand`, the builder's own colour on a band) with its ink; buttons keep their style. none: no fill of its own; the page background shows through (a source colour the palette does not have).

actionsAlign.description: The buttons' alignment. inherit: as the layout sets it. start: at the start edge under centred heading and text (layout centered; a WordPress buttons block with no justification in a centred group). inline and stacked ignore it.

size.description: md: the usual band. lg: a larger heading and more room above and below.

align.description: Alignment of the heading and text (the centred layout already centres them).

mediaSide.description: With a picture: the side it takes on wide screens.

heading.label: Heading
heading.description: The call's heading (Divi CTA title, Elementor call-to-action title).

eyebrow.label: Eyebrow
eyebrow.description: A short line above the heading.

body.label: Text
body.description: One or two sentences under the heading.

note.label: Small print
note.description: A line under the buttons (No credit card required).

image.label: Image
image.description: A small picture beside the text; a large one belongs in a split section.

bgImage.label: Background image
bgImage.description: A picture behind the band; the text turns light and an overlay keeps it readable.

bgOverlay.description: The colour laid over the background image (a hex or rgb colour); default black at 55 %.

href.label: Link
href.description: Where the button goes: a page on this site or a full address.

newTab.label: Open in a new tab
newTab.description: Open the link in a new tab (an external site the reader should not leave for).

style.label: Style
style.description: primary for the main action, secondary or ghost for the ones beside it.

measured.description: The source section's measured style (MeasuredStyle): frame width, padding, fill, image, columns per width, gap, text tone, radius, minimum height — all in pixels. Absent, the site's tokens; present, it wins over tone and columns. Values that are not a number, a colour or a known keyword are dropped.

color.description: Fill colour: hex, rgb(a) or hsl(a).

image.description: Background image address (http(s) or root-relative), drawn behind the content.

overlay.description: Colour laid over the image, with its alpha.

size.description: How the image fills the section.

position.description: One or two of center/top/bottom/left/right or percentages.

columns.description: Item columns at 390 (base), 768 (md) and 1280 (lg) px; a missing width follows the narrower one.

tone.description: What the text is set for: dark = light text on a dark band. Without it, a fill's own lightness decides.

id.description: Anchor id of the section; the heading gets `<id>-title`.

a11y: A labelled region (aria-labelledby its h2). Buttons are links with their own text. Accent tone swaps the primary button style so its contrast holds.
